tracedGeometry.note: Radial reading of the traced outline. This complements the 3x3 zone audit above: the grid places rooms, the radial sectors judge plot shape. Both are served so a cut corner is visible as both a zone defect and a directional deficit.

rooms.note: This room spans 3 directions in this radial split from the plot centre. The placement score uses a different model: the 3x3 grid cell that contains the room's centroid. The split is given so a straddling room is not mis-read.

thresholds.basis: fraction of the SAME wedge of the plot's bounding rectangle (the ideal regular plot). A mean-area baseline is not used: equal-angle wedges are unequal in area on any rectangle, so a mean baseline reports extensions and cuts on a flawless plot.
thresholds.deficitOnlyNote: This reading measures DEFICIT only. The baseline is the plot's own bounding rectangle, which encloses the plot, so a wedge can never exceed 1.0 and a projecting corner (vriddhi) is not expressible here - use /v2/astrology/vastu/plot/extensions-cuts for that grading.
